summary: Tested the grades system teachers refactor (subject + classes instead of التكليفات, import from substitution, Excel import with name matching + Arabic normalization, teacher edit modal, teacher login). All 8 backend pytests pass and UI verified end-to-end.

issues: React validateDOMNesting console warnings: <span> appearing as child of <tbody> and <select>/<option>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up — likely from a stray badge/span rendered outside a <td>/<tr> or inside select's option content. Check GradesLayout table wrappers and the subject <select> options in TeacherEditModal.

action_items: Optional: fix React DOM nesting warnings (span child of tbody/select) — no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: grades.py PUT /teachers/{tid}: when both employee_number/civil_number are cleared, username becomes empty (falls back to old). Consider generating a fallback t{uuid} similar to POST to keep username uniqueness intact.

grades.py import_from_substitution creates username `t{uuid8}` for new teachers, meaning admin has to manually set employee/civil later before the teacher can log in. Acceptable but worth documenting.
GradesTeachers.jsx uses window.confirm() for destructive actions — non-blocking but consider a styled confirm dialog for UX consistency.
seed_data_creation: Excel-import test created 1 TEST_ teacher and added-teacher test created 1 TEST_ teacher; both cleaned up by pytest test_cleanup. Also reset employee_number/civil_number on 'أبو بكر سمير' back to empty after Excel-match test to restore original state. 49 real substitution-imported teachers preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. db.grades_users has 49 teachers imported from substitution with subject+classes populated. Rerunning /api/grades/teachers/import-substitution is idempotent (added=0, updated=49). Excel import matches by Arabic-normalized name (أ→ا, ة→ه, ى→ي, whitespace collapsed) and by employee_number.
